note.note:
Consult Summary:
- 23-year-old female with a several-day history of worsening, constant midline lower abdominal pain (pain score ~8/10) and recent light vaginal bleeding/spotting.
- Plan: arrange face-to-face abdominal and pelvic examination; perform pregnancy test today; urgent review if test positive or if symptoms significantly worsen.

Problem List:

Issue 1:
- Lower abdominal pain: started a few days ago, constant, progressively worse, localized to midline lower abdomen; patient rates pain as approximately 8/10.
- Associated symptoms: nausea without vomiting; intermittent light vaginal bleeding/spotting; recent constipation for about one week last week (now resolved).
- Systems review pertinent negatives: no fever or reported feverish feelings, no vomiting, no fainting, no chest/shoulder pain, no dysuria, no gross blood in stool reported.
- Social/functional: continues regular work and daily activities but pain is very uncomfortable.
- Examination: no physical examination performed during this consult; face-to-face abdominal exam recommended.
- Other: clinician advised abdominal/pelvic examination to determine cause and recommended pregnancy exclusion.

Issue 2:
- Vaginal bleeding/spotting: light pink colored discharge/spotting noticed after period stopped approximately 2–3 weeks ago; described as small/light, not dark.
- Contraception: Implanon implant placed about one year ago; patient reports irregular/sporadic bleeding pattern since implant.
- Sexual history: patient reports recent sexual activity; dates provided in transcript are inconsistent (conflict noted).
- Pregnancy testing: patient had a pregnancy test about one month ago (result not documented in transcript); clinician requested another pregnancy test today and instructed urgent review if positive.
- Examination/assessment: no pelvic exam performed during this consult; clinician recommended face-to-face assessment.

Issue 3:
- Bowel habit change: constipation for approximately one week last week, resolved this week; currently reporting normal bowel motions.
- Associated symptoms: no ongoing diarrhea or hard stool reported currently.

Medications:
- Implanon (contraceptive implant) — dose/route/frequency not documented.
- No other regular medications documented.

Allergies:
- Amoxicillin allergy.

Past Medical History:
- No prior surgeries reported.
- No prior pregnancies reported.
- No other chronic medical conditions documented.

Social History:
- Occupation: school teacher.
- Lives with husband and husband's family.
- Smoking and alcohol use: patient uncertain/ambiguous in the consult (not clearly documented).
- Recreational drug use: patient reports none.
- Recent travel: no recent travel; travel approximately one year ago mentioned.

Preventative History:
- No documentation of cervical screening, mammogram, PSA, FOBT, bone mineral density, or vaccination status in the consult.
- Pregnancy test performed ~1 month ago (result not documented); patient to perform another pregnancy test today as instructed.
- No recent optometry/skin check or other preventive visits mentioned.

Physical Examination:
- No vital signs documented.
- No physical examination performed during this consult; clinician requested face-to-face examination for abdominal and pelvic assessment.

Plan:
- Arrange a face-to-face clinic appointment for abdominal and pelvic examination; patient to contact support line to book (patient agreed).
- Patient to perform a pregnancy test today; if positive, patient instructed to contact clinic and be seen urgently.
- Urgent review advised if symptoms markedly worsen (inability to tolerate fluids, increasing pain) or if vomiting develops.
- After face-to-face assessment, further investigations and management will be determined (e.g., pelvic exam, pregnancy test confirmation, imaging or labs as indicated).

document_quality:

- Missing but clinically expected elements: current vital signs, pregnancy test result (recent and today), medication reconciliation beyond implant, pelvic/abdominal examination findings, laboratory or imaging results.
- Internal conflicts or unclear items from transcript: inconsistent timing of recent sexual activity (patient stated both "four weeks ago" and "four days ago"); travel timing unclear; patient unclear about smoking and alcohol use; pregnancy test performed ~1 month ago but result not documented.
- Transcript quality: portions of the conversation were fragmented and some phrases were inaudible or self-corrected by the patient, resulting in several unclear timestamps and minor ambiguities.
